items.text: Let it be. Jayne fed the troll, lifted the key, and bounced off "take whistle" / "steal whistle" — but seventeen seconds later her own "take cord" fired the troll description, which tells her the whistle is there and what it would cost. She's mid-decision on the one real choice this world has; a voice from the air now would make it for her. Noted for a build turn: `passage-troll` triggers on `*tin*` but not `*whistle*`, so the exact word the description teaches is the one word that room can't hear.
